brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.

requirements.evidence: Built 2-storey L-shaped frame (pieces at 0,0,0/1, 0,1,0/1, 0,2,0, 1,0,0/1) with open faces capped. Provides vertical shelving volume but no dedicated shelf bins; books would sit on top surfaces/caps. Configurator only checks fit, not shelving function.

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: No load rating can be verified. Parts are 3D-printed plastic; configurator checks fit/collisions only (meshClash clear) and does not test materials, strength, or load ratings. A 50 kg rating requires engineering analysis beyond this system.
Two notch drawer frames installed: notch:0#-1,1#notch0 and notch:0#-1,2#notch0 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf)

finish.summary: Modest 2-storey shelf-like frame with two notch drawers. Load rating cannot be met by this system as it only checks geometric fit for 3D-printed plastic.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
